page.layout: One page of text, full width. Running head top centre-left with page number top right. Italic transliteration paragraph at the top, then paradigm headings, Hebrew forms with person labels, and a transliteration paragraph in the middle. Gathering signature at the foot right.

p.i: Tiphkód, tiphkód, tiphkód, tiphkedí, ephkód. Iiphkedú, tiphkódna, tiphkedú, tiphkódna, niphkód.
Iephakkéd, tephakkéd, tephakkéd, tephakkedí, aphakkéd. Iephakkedú, te-phakkédna, tephakkedú, tephakkédna, nephakkéd.

page.notes: The Latin transliteration after the Piel paradigm is printed in italics; the words are copied as printed. The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh in the paradigm forms are small and faint on the scan, so the Hebrew forms are marked [?] throughout. The hyphen after "te" at the line end in "te-phakkédna" is printed. The "te" before "phakkedí" at the line end carries a small mark that could not be read with certainty, so it is written as printed without it. The top italic line is a continuation from the previous page and begins mid-paragraph.
